Decoy keys (`legionxdev/…`, `xlegion.dev/…`, `…-old`) are not read. Realistic pod names and node ids pass entry(). Malformed epochs are skipped, and the loop keeps running

observations: Low, a hand edit only (the gate never writes such a value): annotation() stops at the first quote. A claims value holding an escaped quote in an entry that is NOT last, or using JSON \t or \n as separators, hides every entry after it. With 3 live claims behind such an entry, the gate logs '0 of 3', takes a claim and erases the others, so it fails open by up to 3 extra orders a week. Reproduction: $TMPDIR/t560/GateScriptRecheck/quote_repro.py. TestDispatchCertificateBudgetDropsAnEntryItCannotWrite puts the quoted entry last, so its comment ('costs only that entry') holds only for that position. Round 1 recorded this class as a hand-edit-only observation, and this round keeps that judgement.

Unchanged from round 1: once a pod's flag is set, the check `case " $nodes "` reads the raw registry, so an own entry older than 30 days, or a malformed one, counts as present until another pod's write drops it, and the pod then adds it back on its next pass.
